exposure: Hospital type (Black-serving vs nonBlack-serving, teaching vs nonteaching)
cohort: 5,679,044 deliveries among Black (14.2%) and White patients (85.8%) in California, Missouri, and Pennsylvania from 1995 to 2009
finding: Black patients experience higher maternal in-hospital mortality than White patients, and this disparity persists across hospital types, with excess mortality observed among Black patients within each hospital type and in nonteaching, Black-serving hospitals.
